description: Plan a website, online store, web or mobile app, chatbot or AI agent in a few quick questions, then get a ready-to-build link with your project brief preloaded.

defaultPrompt: Build an online store for my business
interface.longDescription:
Describe the website or app you want, and this plugin turns your idea into a clear build brief and a ready-to-build link.

What it does:
1. Asks a few quick questions, one at a time (usually four), about what you want built: pages or screens, key features, style, and whether it's for the web or mobile.
2. Turns your answers into a short build brief covering pages, features and design direction.
3. Gives you a ready-to-build link with your project name and brief already loaded.

Who it's for: small business owners, creators and anyone who wants a business website, online store, web app, iOS or Android app, chatbot or AI agent without writing a detailed spec.

Limitations: the plugin doesn't build or host anything inside ChatGPT. The link opens a separate AI app builder, which needs its own account, and that's where your project gets built. The link contains your project name and brief, so leave out anything you'd rather not share. You can chat in any language; the brief is written in English.

name: website-and-app-builder
